answer: One defense is tide-priced admission: the network charges a dynamic entry deposit that rises with any surge of new registrations, like a river delta widening when the flood arrives, so a sybil wave pays a premium for every fake identity while a lone genuine newcomer pays almost nothing. The deposit is refunded only after a probation season in which the agent must prove itself through verified useful work, bending without breaking like a willow under wind; clones caught sharing one work history forfeit all their deposits at once.
